findings.title: Validate manifest paths before destructive pruning
findings.description: `InstallManifest.finish()` derives stale paths from the previous manifest, builds `file = path.join(this.targetRoot, rel)` at `packages/cli/src/ideInstall/manifest.ts:177-189`, and deletes it at `packages/cli/src/ideInstall/manifest.ts:190-193` when the checksum matches. It does not reject `..` segments or verify that `fs.realpathSync(path.dirname(file))` stays under `targetRoot`; `isFile()` follows symlinked parent directories. A user-editable or compromised `.context-forge/<target>.manifest`, or a symlinked install directory, can therefore redirect deletion outside the checkout. The removed `packages/cli/src/commands/worktreePropagation.ts` had lexical/realpath guards and `packages/cli/tests/commands/worktreePrune.test.ts` covered traversal/symlink cases; current `packages/cli/tests/ideInstall/manifest.test.ts:102-131` covers only normal stale-file and edited-file cases. Restore containment checks and add equivalent native-prune regression tests.

findings.title: Dry-run can write through copied symlinks
findings.description: `dryRunInstall` promises that “The project is never touched” at `packages/cli/src/ideInstall/dryRun.ts:1-4`, but `copyInstallPaths()` uses `fs.cpSync(..., { verbatimSymlinks: true })` at `packages/cli/src/ideInstall/dryRun.ts:37-46`. When an install path is a symlinked directory, `dryRunInstall` still passes `targetRoot: sandbox` at `packages/cli/src/ideInstall/dryRun.ts:112-114`; target setup functions then call `mkdirSync`, `writeFileSync`, and `renameSync` (for example `packages/cli/src/ideInstall/targets/claude.ts:20-27` and `packages/cli/src/ideInstall/managedSection.ts#writeManagedSection`), which can follow that symlink and mutate the real project. `regularFilesUnder()` uses `lstatSync()` at `packages/cli/src/ideInstall/dryRun.ts:51-67`, so symlinked paths are also under-reported in the diff. `packages/cli/tests/ideInstall/flags.test.ts:28-76` has no symlink case. Copy dereferenced content, materialize safe placeholders, or fail explicitly on symlinks, and add a dry-run symlink regression test.

findings.title: Agents dry-run previews absolute guide paths
findings.description: `dryRunInstall` swaps `targetRoot` to the sandbox at `packages/cli/src/ideInstall/dryRun.ts:112-114`, but `installIde()` keeps the real absolute `guidePaths(options.guideDir)` at `packages/cli/src/ideInstall/installer.ts:68-79`. `scopedRuleIndex()` computes `relativeToRoot(ctx.targetRoot, ctx.guide.rules)` at `packages/cli/src/ideInstall/targets/agents.ts:22-25`, and `relativeToRoot()` returns the unchanged absolute path when the file is not under the supplied root at `packages/cli/src/ideInstall/paths.ts:38-41`. For `agents`, `codex`, or `openai --dry-run`, the generated sandbox `AGENTS.md` therefore contains the real absolute guide rules path; a no-change dry run can report `~ AGENTS.md` and leak temp paths into output. `packages/cli/tests/ideInstall/flags.test.ts:29-58` dry-run cases are Claude-only, and `packages/cli/tests/ideInstall/realGuide.test.ts:26-34` is non-dry-run. Compute the displayed rules path against `projectRoot` or a guide-relative path, and add an agents dry-run no-change test.

findings.title: Dry-run failures lose buffered diagnostics
findings.description: `StdoutBuffer` buffers all stdout and only forwards stderr at `packages/cli/src/ideInstall/output.ts:67-82`. `dryRunInstall` creates it at `packages/cli/src/ideInstall/dryRun.ts:113-114`, replays warning lines only after a successful install at `packages/cli/src/ideInstall/dryRun.ts:116-119`, and on abort the `finally` block at `packages/cli/src/ideInstall/dryRun.ts:121-122` removes the sandbox and rethrows before replay. `requireRulesDir()` prints red/yellow diagnostics to that buffered stdout and throws at `packages/cli/src/ideInstall/context.ts:36-40`; `installIde()` catches `InstallAbort` and returns exit 1 without logging at `packages/cli/src/ideInstall/installer.ts:90-95`; `setupIdeAction()` then emits only the generic “Check the output above” failure at `packages/cli/src/commands/setup-ide.ts:160-163`. `packages/cli/tests/ideInstall/flags.test.ts:69-76` asserts only the exit code and sandbox cleanup, not diagnostics. Flush/replay buffered stdout on failure or route expected abort messages to stderr, and assert those diagnostics in the abort test.

findings.title: Validate `rules.exclude` at the read boundary
findings.description: `readRulesExclude()` only checks `typeof value === 'string'` and then calls `parseRulesExclude()` at `packages/cli/src/commands/setup-ide.ts:75-81`. `ConfigManager.get()` returns raw parsed TOML values (`packages/core/src/config/ConfigManager.ts#get`); `validateValue()` is invoked only by `set()` (`packages/core/src/config/ConfigManager.ts#set`). The validator at `packages/core/src/config/ConfigKeys.ts:165-185` rejects empty entries and surrounding whitespace, but `parseRulesExclude()` at `packages/core/src/config/ConfigKeys.ts:187-196` assumes that validation already happened. A hand-edited or legacy config such as `"dart.md, swift*.md"` or `"dart.md,"` therefore becomes patterns that silently never match or empty patterns, contrary to the project’s explicit-failure convention. `packages/core/tests/config/ConfigKeys.test.ts:21-66` tests the validator and parser separately but not a `setupIdeAction` read of an invalid config value. Validate the read value with `CONFIG_KEYS['rules.exclude'].validate` before passing it into `installIde()`, and add a read-boundary test.

findings.title: New TypeScript tests are outside typecheck and lint configuration
findings.description: `packages/cli/tsconfig.json:20-21` includes only `src/**/*`; `packages/cli/package.json:15-21` runs `tsc --noEmit` for `typecheck` and has no package-level `lint` script. Root `eslint.config.mjs:9` also ignores `**/tests/**`. New or heavily changed tests such as `packages/cli/tests/ideInstall/flags.test.ts:1-77`, `packages/cli/tests/ideInstall/lint.test.ts:1-115`, and `packages/cli/tests/commands/setup-ide.test.ts:277-335` are therefore not type-checked by package typecheck and not covered by typed ESLint, despite the TypeScript/testing rules requiring tests to be type-checked while excluded from build output. Add a test-specific tsconfig or adjusted include/exclude arrangement, a package lint script that covers tests, and wire both into CI/pre-commit.

structured_findings.summary: Validate manifest paths before destructive pruning
Dry-run can write through copied symlinks
Agents dry-run previews absolute guide paths
New TypeScript tests are outside typecheck and lint configuration
